input.query:
WITH ['/managed-ledger-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-broker-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-broker-common-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-client-api-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-client-original-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-common-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-metadata-4.2.5.jar'] AS jars
MATCH (a:Artifact:Jar)-[:CONTAINS]->(t:Type) WHERE a.fileName IN jars AND t.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.apache.pulsar.' AND NOT t.fqn CONTAINS '$'
MATCH (b:Artifact:Jar)-[:CONTAINS]->(s:Type)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(t) WHERE b.fileName IN jars AND s.fqn <> t.fqn AND NOT s.fqn STARTS WITH t.fqn + '$'
RETURN t.fqn, count(DISTINCT s) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 12
